body:
## Purpose

ClimaLand's Downstream CI job runs ClimaCoupler's tests against ClimaLand `main` and PRs. Two checks in `experiments/test/component_model_tests/climaland_tests.jl` fail there (in CliMA/ClimaLand.jl#1928):

1. `propertynames(atmos) == (:h, :gustiness)` fails because ClimaLand's `CoupledAtmosphere` now also stores the height `reference` convention, so the result is `(:h, :reference, :gustiness)`.
2. The flux test errors with `type NamedTuple has no field vapor_flux_liq`. It calls `CL.turbulent_fluxes!` directly on `p.soil.turbulent_fluxes`, but the soil cache stores the vapor flux split into liquid and ice parts, and ClimaLand fills it from the soil skin temperature solve rather than from `turbulent_fluxes!`.

## Changes

- Check only that `:h` and `:gustiness` are among the properties of the coupled atmosphere.
- Replace the three direct `CL.turbulent_fluxes!` calls (canopy, soil, snow) with the land model's own `CL.make_update_boundary_fluxes`, which computes each sub-component's fluxes the way the land model does during a run.
title: Update ClimaLand component tests for current ClimaLand
